thing-type.label: KeContact
thing-type.description: A KEBA wallbox using Modbus TCP with optional UDP and authenticated REST enrichment

parameter-group.name: modbus
parameter-group.label: Modbus TCP
parameter-group.description: Primary connection for measurements and commands, including Modbus proxy connections

parameter-group.name: udp
parameter-group.label: UDP
parameter-group.description: Direct wallbox access for display commands and UDP-only data

parameter-group.name: rest
parameter-group.label: REST API
parameter-group.description: Optional authenticated connection for REST-only data

parameter-group.name: polling
parameter-group.label: Shared Polling
parameter-group.description: Polling settings shared by the wallbox protocols

parameter.name: ipAddress
parameter.label: Modbus Network Address
parameter.description: Address of the wallbox Modbus endpoint or a Modbus proxy

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Fast Modbus Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval for linked fast Modbus values and baseline status

parameter.name: udpIpAddress
parameter.label: UDP Network Address
parameter.description: Direct wallbox address for UDP; leave empty to use the Modbus network address

parameter.name: udpEnabled
parameter.label: Probe UDP Interface
parameter.description: Detect UDP support for display commands and UDP-only channels

parameter.name: baseUrl
parameter.label: REST API URL
parameter.description: HTTPS URL of the wallbox REST API, for example https://192.168.0.10:8443; leave empty to disable REST probing

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: REST Password
parameter.description: Password required when a REST API URL is configured

parameter.name: verifyCertificate
parameter.label: Verify TLS Certificate
parameter.description: Verify the REST server certificate and hostname; disable explicitly for a trusted local self-signed wallbox

parameter.name: refreshIntervalSlow
parameter.label: Slow and Supplemental Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval for slow Modbus values, supplemental REST and required UDP reports

channel-group-type.label: Modbus TCP
channel-group-type.description: Primary Modbus measurements and commands, including derived cable states

channel.description: Current operational state of the wallbox, read from Modbus register 1000.
Enable or disable charging. Commands use Modbus; availability readback comes from REST or UDP when available.
Raw charging-cable state from Modbus register 1004. The wallbox, vehicle and locked switches are derived from this value.
Whether the cable is plugged into the wallbox, derived from cable state when Modbus is available.
Whether a vehicle is connected, derived from cable state when Modbus is available.
Whether the charging plug is locked, derived from cable state when Modbus is available.
Send ON to unlock the charging plug. Charging must be stopped before unlocking.

channel.label: Modbus Error Code
channel.description: Raw numeric wallbox error code from Modbus register 1006; zero means no error. Its encoding is different from REST error names and the two UDP error words.

channel.label: Measured Current Phase 1
channel.description: Actual current drawn by the vehicle on phase 1, measured in amperes; not a current limit or setpoint.

channel.label: Measured Current Phase 2
channel.description: Actual current drawn by the vehicle on phase 2, measured in amperes; not a current limit or setpoint.

channel.label: Measured Current Phase 3
channel.description: Actual current drawn by the vehicle on phase 3, measured in amperes; not a current limit or setpoint.

channel.label: Hardware Current Limit
channel.description: Maximum current supported by the wallbox hardware, from Modbus register 1110. This is not the user setpoint or the current actually drawn by the vehicle.

channel.label: Offered Charging Current
channel.description: Maximum charging current currently offered to the vehicle, from Modbus register 1100. The vehicle may draw less; I1, I2 and I3 report actual measured current.

channel.label: Charging Current Setpoint
channel.description: Requested charging-current limit sent to Modbus register 5004, in amperes. Use maxchargingcurrent to observe the current offered to the vehicle and I1, I2 and I3 for actual current.

channel.label: Voltage Phase 1
channel.description: Measured voltage of phase 1, in volts.

channel.label: Voltage Phase 2
channel.description: Measured voltage of phase 2, in volts.

channel.label: Voltage Phase 3
channel.description: Measured voltage of phase 3, in volts.
Total measured active charging power, in watts.
Measured charging power factor (cos phi), expressed as a percentage.
Total energy consumption reported by the wallbox meter, in watt-hours; added up after completed charging sessions.
Energy delivered in the current charging session, in watt-hours.
RFID tag used for the last charging session, represented by the hexadecimal Modbus RFID register. Only available when RFID is enabled.
Energy limit for an already running or the next charging session. Send an energy quantity, for example in watt-hours.
Communication source allowed to control phase switching: disabled, OCPP, REST, Modbus or UDP.
Number of phases currently used by charging, normally one or three.
Request a phase change: send 0 for one phase or 1 for three phases. This is not the REST toggle command.

channel.label: Failsafe Current Setting
channel.description: Charging-current limit applied after communication is lost, in amperes. This setting is separate from the normal charging-current setpoint.

channel.label: Failsafe Timeout Setting
channel.description: Communication timeout after which the failsafe current is applied, in seconds. This is not the delayed UDP user-current timer.

channel.label: Persist Failsafe Settings
channel.description: Send ON to save the active EMS failsafe settings permanently on a P30 wallbox.
P40-only raw fast-charging status from Modbus register 1200. Removed after a P30 model is identified.

channel.label: Activate Fast Charging
channel.description: Send ON to activate fast charging on P40. Removed after a P30 model is identified.

channel-group-type.label: UDP
channel-group-type.description: Display commands and UDP-only wallbox data

channel.description: Wallbox activation state imposed by the system, reported by UDP Enable sys. This is not the writable user enable command.

channel.label: UDP User Current Setpoint
channel.description: User-requested maximum charging current, in amperes, read from Curr user and changed with the UDP curr command. It is a setpoint, not measured current.

channel.label: UDP User Current Setpoint (%)
channel.description: Percentage representation of maxpresetcurrent, mapped between 6 A and the hardware current limit. Both channels control the same UDP user-current setpoint.

channel.label: Delayed User Current Setpoint
channel.description: Current that will replace the UDP user-current setpoint when currtimertimeout expires. This is the delayed currtime setting, not actual charging current.
Remaining time before the delayed UDP user-current setpoint becomes active, in seconds.

channel.label: Control Pilot Duty Cycle
channel.description: Duty cycle of the control pilot PWM signal, expressed as a percentage. This signal encodes the offered current; it is not a measured phase current.
Whether authentication is required before a charging session can begin.
Authenticate and start a charging session using an RFID tag and RFID class already accepted by the wallbox.
Identifier of the last charging session from UDP report 100.
RFID authorization class used for the last charging session from UDP report 100.

channel.label: X1 Enable Input
channel.description: State of the physical X1 enable input, reported by the UDP Input field. This is separate from the REST x2active flag.

channel.label: X2 Switched Output
channel.description: State of the physical X2 switched output. Send ON or OFF to control it through the UDP output command; X1 is the separate enable input.
Transient wallbox display text sent through UDP on supported P30 models. The setDisplay rule action also allows display-duration limits.

channel.label: UDP Error Word 1
channel.description: Raw UDP Error1 diagnostic value. Retained alongside Error2 for manufacturer troubleshooting; do not treat it as the Modbus numeric error code.

channel.label: UDP Error Word 2
channel.description: Raw UDP Error2 diagnostic value. Interpret together with Error1 using KEBA's error documentation.
Whether communication with the charging backend is present.
System uptime since the wallbox was last reset, in seconds.
Wallbox clock synchronization quality reported by UDP timeQ, from 0 to 3.
Raw UDP setBoot diagnostic value; its semantics are not documented in the UDP Programmer's Guide.

channel.label: DIP Switch Block 1
channel.description: Raw hexadecimal value of DIP-switch block 1, including the UDP enable bit.

channel.label: DIP Switch Block 2
channel.description: Raw hexadecimal value of DIP-switch block 2.

channel-group-type.label: REST API
channel-group-type.description: Authenticated REST data and commands not supplied by Modbus

channel.description: Textual operational state reported by the REST API, for example CHARGING or READY_FOR_CHARGING. This retains REST state names alongside the numeric Modbus state.

channel.label: REST Error Name
channel.description: Wallbox errorCode name reported by REST, for example TEMPERATURE_DERATING. This is complementary to, not numerically equivalent to, the Modbus error code.

channel.label: Reserved
channel.description: Whether the wallbox has an active reservation, reported by the REST reserved field.

channel.label: REST X2 Active
channel.description: Raw x2active flag reported by the REST API. This is not assumed to be the UDP X1 enable-input signal; use udp#inputx1 for that physical input.
Internal wallbox temperature from the REST meter data, in degrees Celsius.

channel.label: External Meter
channel.description: Whether the wallbox reports an external meter through REST hasExternalMeter; not an external-meter energy reading.
Whether a charging session is currently active, reported by REST sessionActive.
Start time of the latest charging session returned by the REST session endpoint.
Duration of the latest charging session, in seconds, from the REST session endpoint.

channel.label: Start Charging
channel.description: Send ON to request that the REST API starts a charging session.

channel.label: Stop Charging
channel.description: Send ON to request that the REST API stops the active charging session.
Whether charging authorization is enabled, reported by REST authorizationEnabled when available.
Enable or disable permanent plug locking through REST. This is a locking policy, not the current physical plug-lock state.

channel.label: Unlock
channel.description: Send ON to request plug unlocking through the REST API.

channel.label: Maximum Phases
channel.description: Maximum number of charging phases supported by the wallbox, reported by REST maxPhases.
Configured phase order reported by REST phaseUsed, rather than just the number of active phases.
Raw JSON array of DIP-switch settings reported by REST. Null entries are preserved.
Named DIP-switch settings returned by the REST interpretation endpoint as a JSON object.

channel.label: Reboot
channel.description: Send ON to request a wallbox reboot through the REST API.
